summary.text: Chelsey Branham is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Joe Fallin for an open seat.
She previously represented District 83 in the Oklahoma House from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Chelsey Branham won the June 26, 2018 Democratic primary for Oklahoma House District 83, defeating Tyler Grey, and then defeated Jason Reese in the November 6, 2018 general election.
She assumed office on November 21, 2018, and was assigned to the Business and Commerce and the Banking, Financial Services, and Pensions committees for 2019-2020.
Eric Roberts defeated Branham, the incumbent, in the November 3, 2020 general election, 51.9% to 48.1%, and she left office on November 18, 2020.
Branham advanced from the Democratic primary on June 16, 2026, to the District 85 general election.
